story_question: Can Yeti deliver the moonberries responsibly after his need to look capable creates a community-sized mess?

hook.image: At breakfast, a purple-blue moonberry pops from a warm loaf, rebounds from the blue kettle and two bowls, and drops perfectly into the basket Yeti happens to raise.
hook.question_created: If one berry is that springy, what will a whole basket do?

setup.goal: Bring Mara's overripe moonberries safely to her Moonberry Market stall before opening bell.
setup.plan: Yeti takes the handcart alone and adds a homemade lever labeled GENTLE-GO so he will never have to admit the hill feels fast.
setup.overlooked_flaw: The lever tightens the basket cover but releases the cart brake; the smooth shortcut is also the steep cart lane.

escalations.cause: Yeti pulls GENTLE-GO when the cart begins to rattle.
escalations.comic_result: The cover clamps down as the brake pops free, sending cart, Yeti, and Tumble downhill in perfect solemn silence for one beat.
escalations.new_stakes: The delivery is moving too fast to steer safely.

escalations.cause: Yeti tries to stop the cart with a laundry line instead of calling June, who is within earshot.
escalations.comic_result: The line becomes a slingshot: the basket lands upright, but six moonberries bounce out in six different rhythms.
escalations.new_stakes: The private delivery problem becomes a public chase.

escalations.cause: Yeti insists he can collect the berries before Mara notices and stretches an awning across the lane without listening to Tumble.
escalations.comic_result: The awning returns every berry at once, gently rearranging three market displays and wrapping Tumble in a purple banner.
escalations.new_stakes: Friends are frustrated, market setup is delayed, and Yeti can no longer hide the mistake.

low_point.choice: When Mara asks where the basket is, Yeti begins to claim that almost everything is under control.
low_point.cost: He sees Tumble stuck in the banner and June silently picking up a display he knocked over; protecting his image has made their work harder.

emotional_turn.realization: Yeti recognizes that looking responsible matters less than being honest with people who are already helping him.
emotional_turn.action: He stops chasing, tells Mara exactly what happened, apologizes to Tumble and June, and asks everyone to help with a plan that starts by listening.

resolution.plan: June maps the bounce rhythm, Tumble resets the cart as a padded catcher, Mara and vendors angle two awnings, and Yeti calls the timing rather than trying to occupy every position.
resolution.planted_payoff: The mislabeled lever now deliberately releases the cart at the right instant; its label flips over to read ACTUAL GENTLE-GO.
resolution.repair: They recover the berries, restore the displays, clean the lane, and open the market together. Yeti carries the light empty basket while sharing credit.

ending_button.image: At the bakery counter, one overlooked berry puffs a tiny flatcake into the air; Yeti calmly catches it in the empty basket without leaving his seat.
ending_button.callback: The basket catch mirrors the opening, but this time Yeti waits, watches, and accepts June's quiet assist when she slides the basket closer.

lesson_in_action: Yeti succeeds only after replacing secrecy and solo scrambling with an honest request, careful listening, and a shared plan. Nobody states the lesson aloud.
